rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: TypeScript-based MCP server providing direct access to WhaTap's monitoring platform through MXQL (Monitoring eXtended Query Language) queries. Enables AI assistants to analyze APM, browser, and infrastructure monitoring data. Features complete authentication flow mimicking WhaTap's mobile app login process, secure session management with AES-256-GCM encryption. Provides both CLI and MCP server interfaces for querying monitoring metrics, retrieving project information, and executing complex MXQL queries with time range filtering. Includes specialized RUM data aggregation across multiple time windows.
